marketActivationBlockerSummary.area: ETDA Digital Platform Service Prior Notification
marketActivationBlockerSummary.description: Under the Royal Decree on Digital Platform Services B.E. 2565, digital platforms facilitating transactions between users must notify the Electronic Transactions Development Agency (ETDA) prior to commencing active operations in Thailand.
Under the Direct Sales and Direct Marketing Act B.E. 2545, online marketplace operators targeting consumers in Thailand must register with the Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB).
Cross-border electronic services exceeding 1.8 million Baht in annual gross turnover from Thai consumers must register for 7% VAT under the e-Service tax regime with the Thai Revenue Department.

matrix.statute: Royal Decree on Digital Platform Service Businesses B.E. 2565 (2022)
matrix.technicalImplications: Annual ETDA notification, transparent terms of service, user notice before changing conditions, takedown of illicit content.

matrix.statute: Electronic Transactions Act B.E. 2544 (2001) as amended
matrix.technicalImplications: Legal enforceability of digital lease contracts and electronic signature validation.

matrix.statute: Consumer Protection Act B.E. 2522 (1979) as amended
matrix.technicalImplications: Rental safety standards, fair contract terms, transparent fee disclosures, dispute resolution mechanism.
Explicit consent for data collection, privacy policy in Thai, data subject rights fulfillment, 72-hour breach reporting.
Ensure adequate data protection standards or contractual clauses (SCCs) for cross-border data transfer to Philippine servers.

matrix.statute: ETDA Platform Rules & MDES Ministerial Notifications
matrix.technicalImplications: Displaying merchant ratings, search ranking parameters, platform fees, and refund dispute mechanisms.

matrix.statute: Consumer Protection Act & OCPB Advertising Rules
matrix.technicalImplications: Clear price display, no deceptive equipment claims, sponsored listing transparency.
Systemic filtering preventing rental of firearms, surveillance wiretaps, unregistered drones, controlled goods.

matrix.statute: Anti-Money Laundering Act B.E. 2542 & ETDA Platform Rules
matrix.technicalImplications: Provider identity verification to prevent ghost listings and equipment fraud.
Display-only THB currency; transaction and payout rails strictly maintained in PHP under Philippine financial authority.
Track gross revenue from Thai consumers; register for 7% e-Service VAT if annual threshold of 1.8M THB is reached.
Confirm specialized equipment categories (heavy machinery, broadcasting gear) do not require specific rental licenses.
Verify valid driver licenses and vehicle insurance if motorized equipment or vehicles are rented.

matrix.statute: Civil and Commercial Code Book III (Hire of Property)
matrix.technicalImplications: Real estate leasing disabled; platform strictly scoped to personal gear and tools.

matrix.statute: Consumer Protection Act & Thai Industrial Standards (TISI)
matrix.technicalImplications: Provider warranty that rented tools and equipment comply with applicable safety standards.

matrix.statute: ETDA Platform Dispute Standard & OCPB Mediation Rules
matrix.technicalImplications: Clear dispute resolution timeline, bilingual complaint channels (Thai and English).
Preservation of electronic rental agreements, payment receipts, and user audit trails for at least 5 years.
Annual submission of digital platform metrics (user counts, gross transaction values, complaint counts) to ETDA.

matrix.statute: ETDA Royal Decree B.E. 2565 & Direct Sales Act
matrix.technicalImplications: Mandatory prior notification to ETDA and direct marketing registration with OCPB.
